in_sanskrit.name: Dorjee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Thunderbolt, Fearless
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dorjee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dorjee is a name of both Hindu and Buddhist origin. In Hinduism, it is a form of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who holds the thunderbolt as a weapon. In Buddhism, Dorjee is the name of the Vajra, a symbol of indestructibility and fearlessness. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dharma-rajaya,' meaning 'ruler of righteousness,' and is associated with the qualities of fearlessness, courage, and protection.
